entry.title: feature flags, revisited
entry.content:
A quick write-up on feature flags, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Feature flags shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: thinking about feature flags

why it matters

Feature flags shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
